principle: Conditional relevance is a conversational state transition, not a truth value and not automatically a deontic obligation.

laws.precondition: P has a context-grounded proposition nucleus
there exists open polar-question(P) and propositionRelation(P,P') ∈ {same-nucleus, refinement-or-update}
laws.caution: answer force alone is insufficient; an irrelevant se-clause does not close the question

laws.precondition: there exists open polar-question(P) and propositionRelation(P,P') identifies the same target nucleus
laws.targetEvidence: unchanged by grammar; optional evidential policy may promote authenticated denial report to against witness

laws.precondition: there exists open question/request relevance about P and P' targets that relevance

laws.deonticEffect: none merely from dialogue force; explicit kod/normative structure is separate

laws.precondition: open request-relevance(P) and P' is same/refinement of requested action
laws.caution: acknowledgement of hearing alone may not entail acceptance/completion; the exact disposition must be read from content

laws.pattern: ku Q in response to open polar-question(P)
laws.note: A counter-question may be relevant without satisfying the original question.

laws.pattern: repair move R addressing prior turn T
laws.caution: repair is not defined by lower graph H1 and may preserve contradiction history

nonlaws: se always closes the latest question
refusal makes the requested proposition false
